verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents an 'API and MCP' section: an official MCP server with OAuth login and workspace selection, plus scoped service keys for agents and scripts to interact with the workspace. That gives programmatic access, but nothing shows the API covers what the UI does. UI-documented actions such as publishing policies, MDM remote actions, Trust Center setup and framework removal have no stated API equivalent, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: any statement or evidence of API/UI feature parity, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, documented API endpoints for core UI workflows (policies, MDM, frameworks, Trust Center), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
